'''Mekamok''' was one of the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gud/Legends|guds]] in the [[Gungan religion|religion]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Serving as the [[Deity/Legends|god]] of destruction, he was believed to be the only one of the guds who lay outside the authority of [[Oma-Oma]], the Gungans' principal deity. Mekamok oversaw other deities relating to [[Death/Legends|mortality]] and decay on Naboo, such as [[Balmtop]], the god of putrefaction and [[Disease/Legends|disease]].<ref name="GB" />

Despite his evil nature, Mekamok still resided in [[Ossorus]], the home of the guds, although the guds loyal to Oma-Oma avoided him. Mekamok and his acolytes still posed a threat to Ossorus, which in turn was guarded by [[Balam]], a formerly mortal [[Militiagung/Legends|militiagung]] turned into the god of war by Oma-Oma.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mekamok's name could be randomly selected as a leader of the Gungan faction in the standard game mode of the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB Eng">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> The character's background was elaborated upon in the Gungan DataBank entry in the game's [[Wikipedia:French language|French]] edition.<ref name="GB" />
